entities.summary: Girolamo Graziani was an Italian poet and diplomat. He served as the secretary of state at the Este court of Modena. He helped establish close diplomatic ties with the court of the Kingdom of France, especially during the 1650s, when a niece of the chief minister of France Cardinal Mazarin served as the new Duchess of Modena. In 1673, Graziani handled the diplomatic aspect of the marriage between Maria Beatrice d'Este (1658–1718), and James Stuart. The marriage had been sponsored by Louis XIV of France.
